bagPolicy.summary: Only A5-size bags or official show merchandise in the provided clear carrier bag may enter. Admitted bags are searched and tagged; large bags and suitcases are prohibited.
allowed: Show merchandise in official clear carrier
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The official concert travel guide advises against residential-street parking and describes the concert bus from Sandhills Station.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The designated post-show pickup and drop-off area is Utting Avenue Car Park; arrange to meet your driver there.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drink vendors operate inside the stadium, with accessible serving counters in most areas. Outside drinks in plastic bottles over 500 ml and glass containers are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair places must be arranged through the disability ticketing team; pitch standing is not wheelchair accessible. Accessible toilets and two Changing Places facilities are available.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The concert stadium-access guide does not state a general rule for exiting and re-entering the stadium.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The club concert access guide does not give one standard Will Call collection process for concerts.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Check the concert ticket and stadium map for the assigned entrance; concert entrance routes can differ from match days. Arriving before doors or camping near the stadium is prohibited.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
